LOTO Training Guide: What You Need to Know for Safe Work

October 30, 2024 · 3 min read

LOTO systems used to ensure safety in work environments increase the importance of lockout safety systems, especially in high-risk industrial areas. In this guide, we introduce the LOTO solutions and products we offer at Sofilx LOTO and explain step by step how you can build a system for the safety of your workers. In particular, we will cover how to maximize your safety with "lockout tagout" in electrical, pneumatic, panel and padlock systems.

What Is LOTO?

Lockout Tagout (LOTO) is a safety system that minimizes workers' accident risk by ensuring energy sources are safely disabled. The lockout equipment used in a LOTO system includes special locks, padlocks, circuit breaker lockouts and tags that prevent machines or circuits from restarting. EKED (Energy Control Tagging and Lockout) is the Turkish equivalent of this practice and provides safety especially during maintenance and repair.

How Do LOTO Systems Work?

Lockout and Tagout (LOTO): Safety padlocks and tags specially designed to secure the machine or circuit to be worked on are used. For example, an electrical lockout ensures safety by cutting off the energy supply.

Lock Options

Pneumatic Locks: In areas that use pneumatic energy, such as air systems, you can ensure safety with pneumatic locks.

Electrical Circuit Breaker Lockouts: Ensures safety by stopping the flow of electricity, especially with panel lockouts.

Padlock Types: Different sizes such as 38 mm and 76 mm padlocks suit different systems. The safety padlocks offered by Sofilx LOTO adapt easily to your work areas.

Lockout Stations and Sets

LOTO Station: Stations used for storing and managing equipment. Padlocks, tags and other LOTO equipment are kept here in an orderly way.

LOTO Kits and Lockout Sets: Offered together to set up a lockout and tagout system, these kits are indispensable in many industrial work areas.

LOTO Tags

Tags stating which worker locked the equipment and when inform other employees and ensure that no one interferes with the locked system.

How Do You Ensure Safety with Sofilx LOTO Products?

Panel Locks: Cut off the flow of energy in panels so that no one can access a locked panel.

Lockout Systems: Offers solutions for every type of energy source with different locking mechanisms.

LOTO Kits and Padlock Types: Options are available for different needs, from personal kits to comprehensive kits.

LOTO Stations: Simplify the LOTO process by keeping and managing equipment together.

Why Is LOTO Training Necessary?

LOTO training ensures that employees use lockout systems correctly while also contributing to the development of a safety culture. Thanks to training:

  • Workers learn which equipment to lock out and how.
  • Knows how to check the locks before working on locked-out equipment.
  • Learns how to perform lockout and tagout and which equipment to use.

LOTO systems are indispensable for the safety of industrial work environments. Sofilx LOTO offers a wide product range, from pneumatic lockouts to circuit breaker lockouts and from padlocks to lockout stations. You can raise your safety level by choosing the most suitable set for your work area.
